desc:
🤼 The most authentic, fully animated Pro Wrestling simulator on Roblox! Wrestle in 1v1, tag team and multiplayer matches and put on 5-star classics.

Create your superstar, design your entrance and chase the championship. Become a legend today!

🌟 FEATURES
• 100+ real wrestling moves, plus finishers, reversals, taunts & dives
• Full Create-a-Wrestler: appearance, movesets & custom entrances
• Singles, Tag Team, Ladder, Cage, Royale & more match types
• Championships, weapons & factions
• Wrestle against real players or NPC opponents
• Community Creations: share & download wrestlers
• PC, mobile & controller support

Inspired by WWE, AEW & NJPW.
From the creator of Wrestling 2X and Undisputed Combat.

🔔 Like ⭐ and favorite for updates!
